display.name: Keeper Services
display.description: Cross-service operational health. Structured operation attempts, raw runtime failures, and telemetry-pipeline health are deliberately separated so retries and wrapper noise are not mistaken for unique incidents.

display.name: service
display.description: Keeper.sh service (service.name)

display.name: Structured Operation Events
display.description: Wide operation events emitted by selected services.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event'

display.name: Error Attempts
display.description: Structured operation attempts with outcome=error. Retries and recurring invalid credentials can heavily amplify this count.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error'

display.name: Services Reporting Errors
display.description: Distinct selected services with at least one structured error outcome.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(resources_string['service.name']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error'

display.name: Unclassified Errors
display.description: Structured errors that reached telemetry without a useful classified slug.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') = 'unclassified'

display.name: Unknown-Service Log Lines
display.description: Log records the telemetry pipeline could not attribute to a Keeper.sh service.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'unknown'

display.name: OTel Metrics Scrape
display.description: Scrape health (up) of the homelab OpenTelemetry collector's own metrics, scraped by its prometheus receiver (service.name otelcol-contrib). Logs may still flow while this is 0; 0 means metrics are blind.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT ifNull(max(value), 0) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'up' AND fingerprint IN (SELECT fingerprint FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'up' AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') = 'otelcol-contrib' AND unix_milli >= intDiv({{.end_timestamp_ms}} - 86400000, 3600000) * 3600000) AND unix_milli >= {{.end_timestamp_ms}} - 300000 AND unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}}

display.name: Operation Outcomes by Service
display.description: Structured operation attempt rate by service and outcome. Missing-outcome lifecycle events are excluded.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] != '' GROUP BY ts, service_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Top Failing Operations
display.description: Failure-attempt rate for the 15 operations with the most failures in the selected range. Repeated retries are intentionally visible.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' AND (resources_string['service.name'], JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name')) IN (SELECT resources_string['service.name'], JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' GROUP BY resources_string['service.name'], JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 15) GROUP BY ts, service_name, operation_name ORDER BY ts

display.name: P95 Operation Duration
display.description: Slowest normalized operations across selected services (the 15 highest P95 over the range).

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') AND (resources_string['service.name'], JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name')) IN (SELECT resources_string['service.name'], JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY resources_string['service.name'], JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') ORDER BY quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) DESC LIMIT 15) GROUP BY ts, service_name, operation_name ORDER BY ts

display.name: HTTP/Auth Traffic by Service
display.description: Request/auth completion rate for API, web, and MCP services.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'type'), '^(http|auth)$') GROUP BY ts, service_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Critical Infrastructure Log Signals
display.description: Log-line signals, not deduplicated incidents. Split by failure class to expose database, connectivity, and process-runtime hazards.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'DB timeout' AS signal, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND match(body, 'ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT|Connection timeout after 30s') GROUP BY ts, signal, service_name ORDER BY ts) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'Connection failure' AS signal, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND match(body, 'ECONNREFUSED|connection refused|Connection closed') GROUP BY ts, signal, service_name ORDER BY ts) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, 'Runtime failure' AS signal, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND match(body, 'SyntaxError|UnhandledPromiseRejection|out of memory|OOM') GROUP BY ts, signal, service_name ORDER BY ts)

display.name: Log Volume by Severity
display.description: All selected log records grouped by service and severity.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, lower(severity_text) AS detected_level, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) GROUP BY ts, service_name, detected_level ORDER BY ts

display.name: Cron Scheduler Outcomes
display.description: Parent source-ingest, destination enqueue, and subscription reconciliation outcomes. Child source results belong on Calendar Sync Health.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-cron' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(ingest-sources|push-destinations.*|reconcile-subscriptions.*)$') GROUP BY ts, operation_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Worker Job Outcomes
display.description: Worker job-level outcomes. Provider reconciliation details belong on Calendar Sync Health.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-worker' AND match(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'), '^(push-sync|sync-aggregate)$') GROUP BY ts, operation_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Top Operations by Volume
display.description: Structured event attempts by normalized operation.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' GROUP BY service_name, operation_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

display.name: Top Operations by Failure Attempts
display.description: Range-total repeated error attempts by normalized operation.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT resources_string['service.name'] AS service_name, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' GROUP BY service_name, operation_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

display.name: Recent Structured Service Errors
display.description: Compact structured summaries; open the log in Logs Explorer when deeper context is required.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS time, resources_string['service.name'] AS service, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS op, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS slug, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['calendar'], 'id') AS calendar FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND attributes_string['outcome'] = 'error' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

display.name: Recent Raw Runtime Errors
display.description: Non-wide error/fatal output catches crashes and wrapper failures that never produced a structured operation event.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS time, resources_string['service.name'] AS service, lower(severity_text) AS level, substring(body, 1, 500) AS body FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND (hasAll({{.service}}, ['keeper-api', 'keeper-cron', 'keeper-worker', 'keeper-web', 'keeper-mcp', 'unknown']) OR has({{.service}}, resources_string['service.name'])) AND match(lower(severity_text), '^(error|fatal)$') AND attributes_string['event_name'] != 'wide_event' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
